title: Ninja Hattori-kun
justification: TVDB 164741 holds AniDB's 694 episodes in seasons of 81, 270, 129, 32, 51, 52 and 79, while the node sent all to season 1. By date and Japanese title: 82 (1982-01-04) = S2E1 Go Fly A Kite, 352 (1983-01-04) = S3E1, 513 (1985-01-14) = S5E1, 564 = S6E1, 616 = S7E1, 694 Yukiyama no Karakuri Sanso = S7E79. TVDB places 162 おかしな外人さんの巻 (1982-04-08) last, at S2E270, so 163-351 sit at S2E81-269; season 3 episodes 105-129 hold AniDB 486-510 (1984-08-20 to 12-17, dated a year early on TVDB) between season 4's 456-485 (S4E1-30) and 511-512 (S4E31-32). AniDB specials S1 "kemumaki ninpou oidashi sakusen no maki", S2 "jidaigeki hatagoninpouchou no maki" and S3 "shinzoudamaru de gozaru! no maki" are TVDB season 0 episodes 2 ケムマキ忍法追い出し作戦の巻 (1984-12-24), 3 時代劇はたご忍法帳の巻 (1985-01-02) and 1 シンゾウ黙るでござる！の巻 (1984-10-08) by title. By default they fell on episodes 1-3 in AniDB's order.
